title: Sectioning of Mouse Proximal Thoracic Aorta
author: Jeff Z. Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be9mjh46
materials: Euthanize mouse with ketamine : xyalazine cocktail
Nick right atrium with sharp scissors
Dissect away the thymus, lungs, trachea, and esophagus
Put a thin layer of OCT in mold
Make sure anti roll plate is not chipped
Put small drop of OCT onto mount

steps.title: Expose and Flush Vasculature
steps.instruction: Open the thoracic cavity to expose the heart and flush the vasculature.

substeps.instruction: Slowly introduce >5 mL of cold saline into the left ventricle to flush the vasculature.

steps.title: Inject OCT Compound
steps.instruction: Inject optimal cutting temperature compound (OCT) into the left ventricle.

substeps.instruction: Slowly inject ~0.5 mL of OCT into the left ventricle to keep it patent; continue injecting until the lumen of the descending aorta expands.

steps.title: Dissect Thoracic Aorta
steps.instruction: Isolate the heart and thoracic aorta from the surrounding anatomy.

substeps.instruction: Ligate the left/right subclavians and common carotids near the thoracic outlet and ligate the aorta above the diaphragm.
Dissect the descending aorta from the spine, ensuring the aorta is not nicked.

steps.title: Separate Heart from Aorta
steps.instruction: Detach the heart from the aorta using forceps and scissors or a scalpel blade, cutting as close to the heart as possible without causing damage.

steps.title: Mount and Embed Tissue
steps.instruction: Position the tissue in a mold and solidify with OCT.

substeps.instruction: Mount the heart, ascending aorta, and descending aorta with the heart facing left and descending aorta on the right.
Mark the position of the aorta in the mold with a permanent marker.
Cover the tissue with OCT.
Place in cryostat with the peltier on for 15 minutes to solidify the OCT.

steps.title: Configure Cryostat Settings
steps.instruction: Set the cryostat parameters and prepare the blade.

substeps.instruction: Set temperature to -20 °C.
Set chuck advance to 10 µm.
Ensure sectioning starts with a new blade or a new region of the blade.

steps.title: Prepare Slides
steps.instruction: Label 10 slides per sample per region (e.g., Study name, mouse ID and group, region collected [ascending or root], and slide number 1-10).

steps.title: Trim and Prepare Tissue Block
steps.instruction: Prepare the solidified tissue block for sectioning.

substeps.instruction: Remove the block from the mold.
Trim excess solid OCT from the tissue while keeping the descending aorta intact.
Cut the heart at the mid ventricle level.
Cut away approximately 60-70% of the ventricles.

steps.title: Mount Block for Sectioning
steps.instruction: Secure the trimmed tissue block onto the holder.

substeps.instruction: Mount the trimmed tissue block with the aortic arch facing up onto the holder.
Place in peltier and wait 10 minutes for the interface to solidify.
Place the holder onto the cryostat chuck with the heart facing down and the descending aorta on top.

steps.title: Perform Sectioning
steps.instruction: Cut sequential sections and verify orientation.

substeps.instruction: Start sectioning, checking every 10 cycles until tissue is visible.
Begin collecting serial sections when the arch divides into the ascending aorta (towards the user) and descending aorta (away from the user).
Verify orientation by counting elastic laminae: Ascending = 8-10 lamina, Descending = 8-6 lamina.
If a section rolls or flips, use an antistatic brush to unroll it.

steps.title: Collect Serial Sections
steps.instruction: Collect at least 9 serial sections per slide at 10 µm/section, for 8 to 10 slides per aorta, until the aortic wall disappears or is no longer intact.

substeps.instruction: Hold labeled slides downward with the label facing the user; ascending aorta should be at the top and descending at the bottom.
Collect the first section on the bottom left corner of slide 1.
Collect the second section on the bottom left corner of slide 2, and subsequent sections in this mode.
Collect the eleventh section to the right of the first section on slide 1.

steps.title: Finalize and Store
steps.instruction: Complete the procedure and store the samples.

substeps.instruction: Stop collecting at the level of the aortic root (where valve leaflet cusps are seen).
Remove the block from the chuck and mount; save or discard excess tissue.
Brush clean all surfaces with 70% ethanol and a brush.
Turn off the light and close the cryostat window.
Store slides in an appropriately labeled slide box (top and one short edge labeled) at -20 °C.
